To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
ATMs are political sites in which power, cash, and convenience are translated into a variety of relationships that serve some interests more than others.
the ATM is a political site that is being translated in ways that make it more powerful, more convenient, and more expensive to use.

the ATM is a political site where the customer and the ATM are translated into each other in ways that serve the interests of the bank, and that the ATM is also a political site where these translations are contested by the customer, the bank, and the ATM.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the politics of the translation of ATMs and their associated cybernetic networks.
the politics of ATM translation.
the politics of ATM networks and how these politics are configured through translations of the ATM.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no comprehensive and detailed conclusive story.
there is no comprehensive and detailed conclusive story to be told about the political site of ATMs, only a multiplicity of stories that are constantly translated and translated again.
the ATM is an ongoing translation of a multiplicity of actors that is configured and translated in ways that serve the interests of those actors who are most powerful.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the ATM is a site where power, convenience, and money are translated into a multiplicity of networks, which in turn are translated into a variety of political effects, some of which are intended, some of which were not.
the ATM is not a neutral, apolitical technology.

, in the United Kingdom at least, the ATM is a political site where power is exercised in a number of ways, primarily through the translation of the machine and its users into a cybernetic network that is designed for the convenience of the bank.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ATM is a cybernetic political site that is not only a site for the translation of power, cash, and convenience, but a site that is itself a translation of these things.
the ATM, like other technological artifacts, is a political site that is always in the making and that it can be used as a tool for political analysis and action.
we need to understand the ATM not simply as a technological device that has been translated into a political site.
